# Crew API: bots (Owner endpoints)

Part of the [Crew API reference](README.md).

## GET /v1/crew/owner/bots

Bot roster (the full list, Owner view).

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Available now: owner only |
| Tier | Owner |
| Stability | experimental |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. |

The full roster as the owner sees it: one row per global Bot, with its private chat with the owner (slot_key, last_message), its configuration (model, workspace, memory store) and its live state. It returns the same data as GET /api/members, from the same handler. The Public GET /v1/crew/bots is the cut-down view apps get: only id, name, description, avatar, status and has_goal, only the grant's Bot range, and never private chat, briefing or rules. While the gateway is still tidying the Bot roster it answers 503 prune_in_progress. The response keeps the members field because it wraps the body of the existing GET /api/members unchanged.

Request headers:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | no | The minor version the client was written for. Without it, the server answers with 1.0 behaviour. The server never refuses a request because this version is old. |
| `X-Request-Id` | string | no | A caller may supply its own; an id assigned by an intermediary in front of the gateway wins. |

Response `200`: One row per global Bot.

Response headers:

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-Id` | string | One id per request, supplied by the caller or an intermediary, or generated by the gateway. Also written to the audit log and the error body. |
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | The server's minor version, for example 1.3. |

Response body fields (`application/json`), [BotRoster](schemas.md#botroster):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `members` | array of [BotRosterRow](schemas.md#botrosterrow) | yes | Field names follow what GET /api/members returns today; the wrapper does not change the shape. |

Errors. The response body is [Error](schemas.md#error); its `error.code` field holds the code.

| Status | Codes | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | `invalid_token`, `stale_session_reauth` | 401: invalid_token, stale_session_reauth. For the Owner tier: no quota headers. |
| 403 | `owner_only` | 403: owner_only. A delegated credential, an embed credential, a local app token and a dashboard session that is not the owner's all get this on the Owner tier; /v1 does not hide routes behind 404. |
| 500 | `internal_error` | 500: internal_error. For embed-credential endpoints: no quota headers. |
| 503 | `instance_unavailable`, `prune_in_progress` | 503: instance_unavailable, prune_in_progress. For the Owner tier: no quota headers. |
